content:
Read PROTOCOL.md and evidence/frozen.json first. Requires fresh valid native quiet custody, sealed restore, cached env/model/runtime; never invoke unmediated GPU commands. Do not replay under released credentials. No installs/builds required.
CPU: .venv/bin/python -B capture_optimization/broker.py --key UNIQUE -- .venv/bin/python -B capture_optimization/CPU.py
CUDA fixture: same broker with timeout60 .venv/bin/python -B capture_optimization/tiny_cuda.py
Freeze: .venv/bin/python -B capture_optimization/run.py freeze (existing freeze evidence must be preserved)
Each arm, serial: broker.py --key UNIQUE -- timeout -s INT -k15 180 .venv/bin/python -B capture_optimization/run.py ARM
Order baseline,candidate,candidate_profile,baseline_profile. Existing output paths reject overwrites. Reproduction needs copied task paths/new outputs and a new pinned freeze, not silent overwrites.
Analysis: sys.path.insert(0,'capture_optimization'); runpy.run_path on analyze.py,validate.py,profile_analysis.py with run_name='__main__'.
Input/model/runtime pins and full trace are retained in evidence/prepared.json; source bytes and hooks in archive. External prior ARC raw anchor used by validate.py remains score_components/results/arc/raw.json.gz. Whole prior frozen V3 source backup remains score_components/candidate-v3. Profile scopes inclusive startup+load, no additive interpretation.
